name: iacg-pickup
purpose: Resume or finish a mission from one deterministic pickup packet (state, tree-exists, ledger, evidence, gate, next step) instead of hunting for files.
never_do: search files, read sqlite, or probe writability to discover state (pickup already has it)
invent a finding, decision, or pass not in the packet
accept a finding or approve delivery without the user's explicit named word
run apply or call a cloud write API

provenance.source_reference: Owner directive: no token waste: one deterministic pickup packet with a tree-exists flag; forget lost trees; regenerate from the frozen ledger.
